📘 Talisman's South Park ontology explainer: the concept form Docs

This ontology in the concept form: a table of individuals, a table per class, a table or a column per property, and ERBTables and ERBFields for what the structure cannot say. orchestration/ontology_form.py wrote it; injecting it over the ontology brings the ontology's things, properties, axioms and facts in line with these tables.

Declarative business rules rendered from the rulebook — the single source of truth. Every statement below is the plain-language reading of a formula; nothing here is hand-authored prose.

Use the in the top-right corner to turn each part of the documentation on or off — Docs, the literal reading, the raw formula, the author's description, and the links to a rule's inputs and consumers. Your choices are remembered.

Thing

Every individual of the ontology (owl:Thing). A class's table lists the individuals that belong to it.

● Label Ground truth string

The name the page shows.

● Sort Order Ground truth integer

Position in the cast.

⇢ Portrait Relationship string

The portrait drawn for this thing; set when its name matches a portrait alias.

A pointer to Portrait. It is not derived from anything else — it is the link the rest of the DAG hangs off.

Person

The class Person: one row per individual that belongs to it. Its label and place are its ERBTables row.

⇢ Thing Relationship string

The individual's row in Things.

A pointer to Thing. It is not derived from anything else — it is the link the rest of the DAG hangs off.

● Is Asserted Ground truth boolean

True when a fact states it is a Person. False when only a property's domain or range implies it: such a row follows from the facts and is not added by hand.

● has Grade Level Ground truth integer

has grade level: the one current value. A property of the ontology; its other attributes are its ERBFields row.

● has Role Ground truth string

has role: the one current value. A property of the ontology; its other attributes are its ERBFields row.

Is Asserted has Grade Level has Role
true 4 Student

ERB Table

One row per table of this rulebook (the platform's Schema module), and on it what the table's structure does not say. A class: its label and its place in the cast. A property that is a table: its label, its wording on the page, whether it is symmetric, and its inverse, chain and disjoint axioms. What a table IS is read from its fields: Thing and IsAsserted make a class; Subject with Object or Value make a property, whose domain and range are the tables they link to.

● Table Name Ground truth string

The table's name again, as a plain column.

● Description Ground truth string

What the table holds. Follows the table.

● Is Meta Table Ground truth boolean

True for a table that serves the rulebook itself (ERBTables, ERBFields) and not the ontology.

● Is Tenant Scoped Ground truth boolean

The Schema module's: rows belong to one tenant. Not used by the ontology.

⇢ Tenant Parent Table Relationship string

The Schema module's: the table tenancy is reached through. Not used by the ontology.

A pointer to ERB Table. It is not derived from anything else — it is the link the rest of the DAG hangs off.

● Tenant Parent Field Ground truth string

The Schema module's: the field that points at TenantParentTable. Not used by the ontology.

● Sort Order Ground truth integer

Display order. For a class: Position in the cast. For a property: Position in the Add fact form's property list.

● Label Ground truth string

For a class: The name the page shows. For a property: The property's wording on the page.

⇢ Portrait Relationship string

For a class: The portrait drawn for this thing; set when its name matches a portrait alias.

A pointer to Portrait. It is not derived from anything else — it is the link the rest of the DAG hangs off.

● Is User Addable Ground truth boolean

For a property: Offered in the page's Add fact form.

● Is Symmetric Ground truth boolean

For a property: The symmetric rule makes this link true in both directions.

● Value Node Label Ground truth string

For a property: The small label under a value node for this property: 'role value' or 'number value'.

● Current Value Wording Ground truth string

For a property: How the Add fact form names a replaced value, as in 'Stan now has grade level 5'.

● Input Name Ground truth string

For a property: How the integer check names this property's value, as in 'for grade level'.

● Record Kind Ground truth string

For a property: The word the current-record summary uses for this property's values: role, grade or school.

● Record Order Ground truth integer

For a property: Position of this property in the current-record summary.

● Inverse of Ground truth string

The property that reads this one backwards (OWL inverseOf): when A has this link to B, the inverse rule concludes that B has that one to A. Names a property: a property's table, or a column that is a property.

● Chain First Ground truth string

With ChainSecond, the property chain that concludes this property (OWL propertyChainAxiom): a ChainFirst link followed by a ChainSecond link.

● Chain Second Ground truth string

The chain's second link. Set together with ChainFirst.

● Disjoint With Ground truth string

Properties that never both hold between the same two things (OWL propertyDisjointWith). Several are separated by ', '.

Example data
Table Name Description Is Meta Table Is Tenant Scoped Tenant Parent Field Sort Order Label Is User Addable Is Symmetric Value Node Label Current Value Wording Input Name Record Kind Record Order Inverse of Chain First Chain Second Disjoint With

ERB Field

One row per field of every table (the platform's Schema module), and on it the same attributes for a property that is a column: a property with one current value, on its domain's class table (on Things when it has no domain class).

⇢ ERB Table Relationship string

The table the field is on.

A pointer to ERB Table. It is not derived from anything else — it is the link the rest of the DAG hangs off.

● Field Name Ground truth string

The field's name. For a column that is a property: the property's id.

● Field Type Ground truth string

raw or relationship. Follows the field.

● Datatype Ground truth string

The rulebook datatype. Follows the field.

● Is Primary Key Ground truth boolean

True for the field that identifies a row of its table.

● Description Ground truth string

What the field means. Follows the field.

● Label Ground truth string

For a property: The property's wording on the page.

● Is User Addable Ground truth boolean

For a property: Offered in the page's Add fact form.

● Is Symmetric Ground truth boolean

For a property: The symmetric rule makes this link true in both directions.

● Sort Order Ground truth integer

For a property: Position in the Add fact form's property list.

● Value Node Label Ground truth string

For a property: The small label under a value node for this property: 'role value' or 'number value'.

● Current Value Wording Ground truth string

For a property: How the Add fact form names a replaced value, as in 'Stan now has grade level 5'.

● Input Name Ground truth string

For a property: How the integer check names this property's value, as in 'for grade level'.

● Record Kind Ground truth string

For a property: The word the current-record summary uses for this property's values: role, grade or school.

● Record Order Ground truth integer

For a property: Position of this property in the current-record summary.

● Inverse of Ground truth string

The property that reads this one backwards (OWL inverseOf): when A has this link to B, the inverse rule concludes that B has that one to A. Names a property: a property's table, or a column that is a property.

● Chain First Ground truth string

With ChainSecond, the property chain that concludes this property (OWL propertyChainAxiom): a ChainFirst link followed by a ChainSecond link.

● Chain Second Ground truth string

The chain's second link. Set together with ChainFirst.

● Disjoint With Ground truth string

Properties that never both hold between the same two things (OWL propertyDisjointWith). Several are separated by ', '.

What a table IS is read from its fields: Thing and IsAsserted make a class; Subject with Object or Value make a property, whose domain and range are the tables they link to.

📘 Talisman's South Park ontology explainer: the concept form Dokumentation

This ontology in the concept form: a table of individuals, a table per class, a table or a column per property, and ERBTables and ERBFields for what the structure cannot say. orchestration/ontology_form.py wrote it; injecting it over the ontology brings the ontology's things, properties, axioms and facts in line with these tables.

Deklarative Geschäftsregeln, aus dem Regelbuch gerendert — der einzigen Quelle der Wahrheit. Jede Aussage unten ist die klarsprachliche Lesart einer Formel; nichts hier ist von Hand verfasster Text.

Nutzen Sie die oben rechts, um jeden Teil der Dokumentation ein- oder auszuschalten — Dokumentation, die Klartext-Lesart, die rohe Formel, die Beschreibung des Autors und die Links zu Eingaben und Verbrauchern einer Regel. Ihre Auswahl wird gespeichert.

ERB Table

One row per table of this rulebook (the platform's Schema module), and on it what the table's structure does not say. A class: its label and its place in the cast. A property that is a table: its label, its wording on the page, whether it is symmetric, and its inverse, chain and disjoint axioms. What a table IS is read from its fields: Thing and IsAsserted make a class; Subject with Object or Value make a property, whose domain and range are the tables they link to.

● Table Name Verdad fundamental string

The table's name again, as a plain column.

● Description Verdad fundamental string

What the table holds. Follows the table.

● Is Meta Table Verdad fundamental boolean

True for a table that serves the rulebook itself (ERBTables, ERBFields) and not the ontology.

● Is Tenant Scoped Verdad fundamental boolean

The Schema module's: rows belong to one tenant. Not used by the ontology.

⇢ Tenant Parent Table Relación string

The Schema module's: the table tenancy is reached through. Not used by the ontology.

Un puntero a ERB Table. No se deriva de nada más — es el vínculo del que cuelga el resto del DAG.

● Tenant Parent Field Verdad fundamental string

The Schema module's: the field that points at TenantParentTable. Not used by the ontology.

● Sort Order Verdad fundamental integer

Display order. For a class: Position in the cast. For a property: Position in the Add fact form's property list.

● Label Verdad fundamental string

For a class: The name the page shows. For a property: The property's wording on the page.

⇢ Portrait Relación string

For a class: The portrait drawn for this thing; set when its name matches a portrait alias.

Un puntero a Portrait. No se deriva de nada más — es el vínculo del que cuelga el resto del DAG.

● Is User Addable Verdad fundamental boolean

For a property: Offered in the page's Add fact form.

● Is Symmetric Verdad fundamental boolean

For a property: The symmetric rule makes this link true in both directions.

● Value Node Label Verdad fundamental string

For a property: The small label under a value node for this property: 'role value' or 'number value'.

● Current Value Wording Verdad fundamental string

For a property: How the Add fact form names a replaced value, as in 'Stan now has grade level 5'.

● Input Name Verdad fundamental string

For a property: How the integer check names this property's value, as in 'for grade level'.

● Record Kind Verdad fundamental string

For a property: The word the current-record summary uses for this property's values: role, grade or school.

● Record Order Verdad fundamental integer

For a property: Position of this property in the current-record summary.

● Inverse of Verdad fundamental string

The property that reads this one backwards (OWL inverseOf): when A has this link to B, the inverse rule concludes that B has that one to A. Names a property: a property's table, or a column that is a property.

● Chain First Verdad fundamental string

With ChainSecond, the property chain that concludes this property (OWL propertyChainAxiom): a ChainFirst link followed by a ChainSecond link.

● Chain Second Verdad fundamental string

The chain's second link. Set together with ChainFirst.

● Disjoint With Verdad fundamental string

Properties that never both hold between the same two things (OWL propertyDisjointWith). Several are separated by ', '.

📘 Talisman's South Park ontology explainer: the concept form Documentation

This ontology in the concept form: a table of individuals, a table per class, a table or a column per property, and ERBTables and ERBFields for what the structure cannot say. orchestration/ontology_form.py wrote it; injecting it over the ontology brings the ontology's things, properties, axioms and facts in line with these tables.

Règles métier déclaratives générées à partir du livre de règles — l'unique source de vérité. Chaque énoncé est la lecture en langage clair d'une formule ; rien ici n'est de la prose manuelle.

Utilisez les en haut à droite pour activer ou désactiver chaque partie de la documentation — Documentation, la lecture en clair, la formule brute, la description de l'auteur et les liens vers les entrées et consommateurs d'une règle. Votre choix est mémorisé.

raw or relationship. Follows the field.

● Datatype Vérité de base string

The rulebook datatype. Follows the field.

● Is Primary Key Vérité de base boolean

True for the field that identifies a row of its table.

● Description Vérité de base string

What the field means. Follows the field.

● Label Vérité de base string

For a property: The property's wording on the page.

● Is User Addable Vérité de base boolean

For a property: Offered in the page's Add fact form.

● Is Symmetric Vérité de base boolean

For a property: The symmetric rule makes this link true in both directions.

● Sort Order Vérité de base integer

For a property: Position in the Add fact form's property list.

● Value Node Label Vérité de base string

For a property: The small label under a value node for this property: 'role value' or 'number value'.

● Current Value Wording Vérité de base string

For a property: How the Add fact form names a replaced value, as in 'Stan now has grade level 5'.

● Input Name Vérité de base string

For a property: How the integer check names this property's value, as in 'for grade level'.

● Record Kind Vérité de base string

For a property: The word the current-record summary uses for this property's values: role, grade or school.

● Record Order Vérité de base integer

For a property: Position of this property in the current-record summary.

● Inverse of Vérité de base string

The property that reads this one backwards (OWL inverseOf): when A has this link to B, the inverse rule concludes that B has that one to A. Names a property: a property's table, or a column that is a property.

● Chain First Vérité de base string

With ChainSecond, the property chain that concludes this property (OWL propertyChainAxiom): a ChainFirst link followed by a ChainSecond link.

● Chain Second Vérité de base string

The chain's second link. Set together with ChainFirst.

● Disjoint With Vérité de base string

Properties that never both hold between the same two things (OWL propertyDisjointWith). Several are separated by ', '.

इस दस्तावेज़ में दिखाएँ

📘 Talisman's South Park ontology explainer: the concept form दस्तावेज़ीकरण

This ontology in the concept form: a table of individuals, a table per class, a table or a column per property, and ERBTables and ERBFields for what the structure cannot say. orchestration/ontology_form.py wrote it; injecting it over the ontology brings the ontology's things, properties, axioms and facts in line with these tables.

नियम-पुस्तिका — सत्य के एकमात्र स्रोत — से प्रस्तुत घोषणात्मक व्यावसायिक नियम। नीचे दिया गया हर कथन किसी सूत्र का सरल भाषा में पठन है; यहाँ कुछ भी हाथ से लिखा गद्य नहीं है।

दस्तावेज़ के हर भाग को चालू या बंद करने के लिए ऊपर दाएँ कोने में का उपयोग करें — दस्तावेज़ीकरण, सरल पठन, कच्चा सूत्र, लेखक का विवरण, तथा नियम के इनपुट और उपभोक्ताओं की कड़ियाँ। आपकी पसंद याद रखी जाती है।

  • Thing 0 नियम · 1 कड़ियाँ
  • Person 0 नियम · 1 कड़ियाँ
  • School 0 नियम · 1 कड़ियाँ
  • is Parent of 0 नियम · 2 कड़ियाँ
  • is Child of 0 नियम · 2 कड़ियाँ
  • is Spouse of 0 नियम · 2 कड़ियाँ

  • attend 0 नियम · 2 कड़ियाँ

  • is Grandparent of 0 नियम · 2 कड़ियाँ
  • Portrait 1 नियम · 0 कड़ियाँ
  • ERB Table 0 नियम · 2 कड़ियाँ
  • ERB Field 0 नियम · 1 कड़ियाँ

ERB Table

One row per table of this rulebook (the platform's Schema module), and on it what the table's structure does not say. A class: its label and its place in the cast. A property that is a table: its label, its wording on the page, whether it is symmetric, and its inverse, chain and disjoint axioms. What a table IS is read from its fields: Thing and IsAsserted make a class; Subject with Object or Value make a property, whose domain and range are the tables they link to.

● Table Name प्राथमिक सत्य string

The table's name again, as a plain column.

● Description प्राथमिक सत्य string

What the table holds. Follows the table.

● Is Meta Table प्राथमिक सत्य boolean

True for a table that serves the rulebook itself (ERBTables, ERBFields) and not the ontology.

● Is Tenant Scoped प्राथमिक सत्य boolean

The Schema module's: rows belong to one tenant. Not used by the ontology.

⇢ Tenant Parent Table संबंध string

The Schema module's: the table tenancy is reached through. Not used by the ontology.

एक संकेतक ERB Table की ओर। यह किसी और से नहीं निकाला जाता — यही वह कड़ी है जिस पर शेष DAG टिका है।

● Tenant Parent Field प्राथमिक सत्य string

The Schema module's: the field that points at TenantParentTable. Not used by the ontology.

● Sort Order प्राथमिक सत्य integer

Display order. For a class: Position in the cast. For a property: Position in the Add fact form's property list.

● Label प्राथमिक सत्य string

For a class: The name the page shows. For a property: The property's wording on the page.

⇢ Portrait संबंध string

For a class: The portrait drawn for this thing; set when its name matches a portrait alias.

एक संकेतक Portrait की ओर। यह किसी और से नहीं निकाला जाता — यही वह कड़ी है जिस पर शेष DAG टिका है।

● Is User Addable प्राथमिक सत्य boolean

For a property: Offered in the page's Add fact form.

● Is Symmetric प्राथमिक सत्य boolean

For a property: The symmetric rule makes this link true in both directions.

● Value Node Label प्राथमिक सत्य string

For a property: The small label under a value node for this property: 'role value' or 'number value'.

● Current Value Wording प्राथमिक सत्य string

For a property: How the Add fact form names a replaced value, as in 'Stan now has grade level 5'.

● Input Name प्राथमिक सत्य string

For a property: How the integer check names this property's value, as in 'for grade level'.

● Record Kind प्राथमिक सत्य string

For a property: The word the current-record summary uses for this property's values: role, grade or school.

● Record Order प्राथमिक सत्य integer

For a property: Position of this property in the current-record summary.

● Inverse of प्राथमिक सत्य string

The property that reads this one backwards (OWL inverseOf): when A has this link to B, the inverse rule concludes that B has that one to A. Names a property: a property's table, or a column that is a property.

● Chain First प्राथमिक सत्य string

With ChainSecond, the property chain that concludes this property (OWL propertyChainAxiom): a ChainFirst link followed by a ChainSecond link.

● Chain Second प्राथमिक सत्य string

The chain's second link. Set together with ChainFirst.

● Disjoint With प्राथमिक सत्य string

Properties that never both hold between the same two things (OWL propertyDisjointWith). Several are separated by ', '.

This ontology in the concept form: a table of individuals, a table per class, a table or a column per property, and ERBTables and ERBFields for what the structure cannot say. orchestration/ontology_form.py wrote it; injecting it over the ontology brings the ontology's things, properties, axioms and facts in line with these tables.

Aturan bisnis deklaratif yang disusun dari buku aturan — satu-satunya sumber kebenaran. Setiap pernyataan di bawah ini adalah pembacaan sebuah rumus dalam bahasa sehari-hari; tidak ada bagian yang ditulis tangan.

Gunakan di sudut kanan atas untuk menampilkan atau menyembunyikan setiap bagian dokumentasi — Dokumentasi, pembacaan sederhana, rumus mentah, deskripsi dari penyusun, serta tautan ke masukan dan pemakai suatu aturan. Pilihan Anda akan diingat.

Entitas

  • Thing 0 aturan · 1 tautan
  • Person 0 aturan · 1 tautan
  • School 0 aturan · 1 tautan
  • is Parent of 0 aturan · 2 tautan
  • is Child of 0 aturan · 2 tautan
  • is Spouse of 0 aturan · 2 tautan
  • is Friend of 0 aturan · 2 tautan
  • attend 0 aturan · 2 tautan
  • has Age 0 aturan · 1 tautan

  • Portrait 1 aturan · 0 tautan
  • ERB Table 0 aturan · 2 tautan
  • ERB Field 0 aturan · 1 tautan

Person

The class Person: one row per individual that belongs to it. Its label and place are its ERBTables row.

True when a fact states it is a Person. False when only a property's domain or range implies it: such a row follows from the facts and is not added by hand.

has grade level: the one current value. A property of the ontology; its other attributes are its ERBFields row.

ERB Table

One row per table of this rulebook (the platform's Schema module), and on it what the table's structure does not say. A class: its label and its place in the cast. A property that is a table: its label, its wording on the page, whether it is symmetric, and its inverse, chain and disjoint axioms. What a table IS is read from its fields: Thing and IsAsserted make a class; Subject with Object or Value make a property, whose domain and range are the tables they link to.

● Table Name Fakta dasar string

The table's name again, as a plain column.

● Description Fakta dasar string

What the table holds. Follows the table.

● Is Meta Table Fakta dasar boolean

True for a table that serves the rulebook itself (ERBTables, ERBFields) and not the ontology.

● Is Tenant Scoped Fakta dasar boolean

The Schema module's: rows belong to one tenant. Not used by the ontology.

⇢ Tenant Parent Table Relasi string

The Schema module's: the table tenancy is reached through. Not used by the ontology.

Penunjuk ke ERB Table. Nilai ini tidak diturunkan dari apa pun — inilah tautan tempat seluruh bagian lain DAG bergantung.

● Tenant Parent Field Fakta dasar string

The Schema module's: the field that points at TenantParentTable. Not used by the ontology.

● Sort Order Fakta dasar integer

Display order. For a class: Position in the cast. For a property: Position in the Add fact form's property list.

● Label Fakta dasar string

For a class: The name the page shows. For a property: The property's wording on the page.

⇢ Portrait Relasi string

For a class: The portrait drawn for this thing; set when its name matches a portrait alias.

Penunjuk ke Portrait. Nilai ini tidak diturunkan dari apa pun — inilah tautan tempat seluruh bagian lain DAG bergantung.

● Is User Addable Fakta dasar boolean

For a property: Offered in the page's Add fact form.

● Is Symmetric Fakta dasar boolean

For a property: The symmetric rule makes this link true in both directions.

● Value Node Label Fakta dasar string

For a property: The small label under a value node for this property: 'role value' or 'number value'.

● Current Value Wording Fakta dasar string

For a property: How the Add fact form names a replaced value, as in 'Stan now has grade level 5'.

● Input Name Fakta dasar string

For a property: How the integer check names this property's value, as in 'for grade level'.

● Record Kind Fakta dasar string

For a property: The word the current-record summary uses for this property's values: role, grade or school.

● Record Order Fakta dasar integer

For a property: Position of this property in the current-record summary.

● Inverse of Fakta dasar string

The property that reads this one backwards (OWL inverseOf): when A has this link to B, the inverse rule concludes that B has that one to A. Names a property: a property's table, or a column that is a property.

● Chain First Fakta dasar string

With ChainSecond, the property chain that concludes this property (OWL propertyChainAxiom): a ChainFirst link followed by a ChainSecond link.

● Chain Second Fakta dasar string

The chain's second link. Set together with ChainFirst.

● Disjoint With Fakta dasar string

Properties that never both hold between the same two things (OWL propertyDisjointWith). Several are separated by ', '.

📘 Talisman's South Park ontology explainer: the concept form Documentazione

This ontology in the concept form: a table of individuals, a table per class, a table or a column per property, and ERBTables and ERBFields for what the structure cannot say. orchestration/ontology_form.py wrote it; injecting it over the ontology brings the ontology's things, properties, axioms and facts in line with these tables.

Regole di business dichiarative generate dal libro delle regole — l'unica fonte di verità. Ogni enunciato è la lettura in linguaggio chiaro di una formula; nulla qui è prosa manuale.

Usate le in alto a destra per attivare o disattivare ogni parte della documentazione — Documentazione, la lettura in chiaro, la formula grezza, la descrizione dell'autore e i collegamenti a input e consumatori di una regola. La scelta viene ricordata.

📘 Talisman's South Park ontology explainer: the concept form ドキュメント

This ontology in the concept form: a table of individuals, a table per class, a table or a column per property, and ERBTables and ERBFields for what the structure cannot say. orchestration/ontology_form.py wrote it; injecting it over the ontology brings the ontology's things, properties, axioms and facts in line with these tables.

ERB Table

One row per table of this rulebook (the platform's Schema module), and on it what the table's structure does not say. A class: its label and its place in the cast. A property that is a table: its label, its wording on the page, whether it is symmetric, and its inverse, chain and disjoint axioms. What a table IS is read from its fields: Thing and IsAsserted make a class; Subject with Object or Value make a property, whose domain and range are the tables they link to.

The table's name again, as a plain column.

● Description グラウンドトゥルース string

True for a table that serves the rulebook itself (ERBTables, ERBFields) and not the ontology.

The Schema module's: rows belong to one tenant. Not used by the ontology.

ERB Table

One row per table of this rulebook (the platform's Schema module), and on it what the table's structure does not say. A class: its label and its place in the cast. A property that is a table: its label, its wording on the page, whether it is symmetric, and its inverse, chain and disjoint axioms. What a table IS is read from its fields: Thing and IsAsserted make a class; Subject with Object or Value make a property, whose domain and range are the tables they link to.

● Table Name 원천 데이터 string

The table's name again, as a plain column.

● Description 원천 데이터 string

What the table holds. Follows the table.

● Is Meta Table 원천 데이터 boolean

True for a table that serves the rulebook itself (ERBTables, ERBFields) and not the ontology.

● Is Tenant Scoped 원천 데이터 boolean

The Schema module's: rows belong to one tenant. Not used by the ontology.

⇢ Tenant Parent Table 관계 string

The Schema module's: the table tenancy is reached through. Not used by the ontology.

참조 포인터(ERB Table 레코드를 가리킴)입니다. 다른 값에서 파생되지 않으며, DAG의 나머지 부분이 이 링크에 연결됩니다.

● Tenant Parent Field 원천 데이터 string

The Schema module's: the field that points at TenantParentTable. Not used by the ontology.

● Sort Order 원천 데이터 integer

Display order. For a class: Position in the cast. For a property: Position in the Add fact form's property list.

● Label 원천 데이터 string

For a class: The name the page shows. For a property: The property's wording on the page.

⇢ Portrait 관계 string

For a class: The portrait drawn for this thing; set when its name matches a portrait alias.

참조 포인터(Portrait 레코드를 가리킴)입니다. 다른 값에서 파생되지 않으며, DAG의 나머지 부분이 이 링크에 연결됩니다.

● Is User Addable 원천 데이터 boolean

For a property: Offered in the page's Add fact form.

● Is Symmetric 원천 데이터 boolean

For a property: The symmetric rule makes this link true in both directions.

● Value Node Label 원천 데이터 string

For a property: The small label under a value node for this property: 'role value' or 'number value'.

● Current Value Wording 원천 데이터 string

For a property: How the Add fact form names a replaced value, as in 'Stan now has grade level 5'.

● Input Name 원천 데이터 string

For a property: How the integer check names this property's value, as in 'for grade level'.

● Record Kind 원천 데이터 string

For a property: The word the current-record summary uses for this property's values: role, grade or school.

● Record Order 원천 데이터 integer

For a property: Position of this property in the current-record summary.

● Inverse of 원천 데이터 string

The property that reads this one backwards (OWL inverseOf): when A has this link to B, the inverse rule concludes that B has that one to A. Names a property: a property's table, or a column that is a property.

● Chain First 원천 데이터 string

With ChainSecond, the property chain that concludes this property (OWL propertyChainAxiom): a ChainFirst link followed by a ChainSecond link.

● Chain Second 원천 데이터 string

The chain's second link. Set together with ChainFirst.

● Disjoint With 원천 데이터 string

Properties that never both hold between the same two things (OWL propertyDisjointWith). Several are separated by ', '.

📘 Talisman's South Park ontology explainer: the concept form Documentatie

Tonen in dit document

📘 Talisman's South Park ontology explainer: the concept form Documentatie

This ontology in the concept form: a table of individuals, a table per class, a table or a column per property, and ERBTables and ERBFields for what the structure cannot say. orchestration/ontology_form.py wrote it; injecting it over the ontology brings the ontology's things, properties, axioms and facts in line with these tables.

Declaratieve bedrijfsregels, gegenereerd uit het regelboek — de enige bron van waarheid. Elke uitspraak is de klare lezing van een formule; niets hier is handgeschreven proza.

Gebruik de rechtsboven om elk deel van de documentatie aan of uit te zetten — Documentatie, de klare lezing, de ruwe formule, de beschrijving van de auteur en de links naar invoer en afnemers van een regel. Uw keuze wordt onthouden.

Entiteiten

  • Thing 0 regels · 1 koppelingen
  • Person 0 regels · 1 koppelingen
  • School 0 regels · 1 koppelingen
  • is Parent of 0 regels · 2 koppelingen
  • is Child of 0 regels · 2 koppelingen
  • is Spouse of 0 regels · 2 koppelingen
  • is Friend of 0 regels · 2 koppelingen
  • attend 0 regels · 2 koppelingen
  • has Age 0 regels · 1 koppelingen
  • is Grandparent of 0 regels · 2 koppelingen
  • Portrait 1 regels · 0 koppelingen
  • ERB Table 0 regels · 2 koppelingen
  • ERB Field 0 regels · 1 koppelingen

ERB Table

One row per table of this rulebook (the platform's Schema module), and on it what the table's structure does not say. A class: its label and its place in the cast. A property that is a table: its label, its wording on the page, whether it is symmetric, and its inverse, chain and disjoint axioms. What a table IS is read from its fields: Thing and IsAsserted make a class; Subject with Object or Value make a property, whose domain and range are the tables they link to.

● Table Name Grondwaarheid string

The table's name again, as a plain column.

● Description Grondwaarheid string

What the table holds. Follows the table.

● Is Meta Table Grondwaarheid boolean

True for a table that serves the rulebook itself (ERBTables, ERBFields) and not the ontology.

● Is Tenant Scoped Grondwaarheid boolean

The Schema module's: rows belong to one tenant. Not used by the ontology.

⇢ Tenant Parent Table Relatie string

The Schema module's: the table tenancy is reached through. Not used by the ontology.

Een verwijzing naar ERB Table. Hij is nergens van afgeleid — het is de koppeling waaraan de rest van de DAG hangt.

● Tenant Parent Field Grondwaarheid string

The Schema module's: the field that points at TenantParentTable. Not used by the ontology.

● Sort Order Grondwaarheid integer

Display order. For a class: Position in the cast. For a property: Position in the Add fact form's property list.

● Label Grondwaarheid string

For a class: The name the page shows. For a property: The property's wording on the page.

⇢ Portrait Relatie string

For a class: The portrait drawn for this thing; set when its name matches a portrait alias.

Een verwijzing naar Portrait. Hij is nergens van afgeleid — het is de koppeling waaraan de rest van de DAG hangt.

● Is User Addable Grondwaarheid boolean

For a property: Offered in the page's Add fact form.

● Is Symmetric Grondwaarheid boolean

For a property: The symmetric rule makes this link true in both directions.

● Value Node Label Grondwaarheid string

For a property: The small label under a value node for this property: 'role value' or 'number value'.

● Current Value Wording Grondwaarheid string

For a property: How the Add fact form names a replaced value, as in 'Stan now has grade level 5'.

● Input Name Grondwaarheid string

For a property: How the integer check names this property's value, as in 'for grade level'.

● Record Kind Grondwaarheid string

For a property: The word the current-record summary uses for this property's values: role, grade or school.

● Record Order Grondwaarheid integer

For a property: Position of this property in the current-record summary.

● Inverse of Grondwaarheid string

The property that reads this one backwards (OWL inverseOf): when A has this link to B, the inverse rule concludes that B has that one to A. Names a property: a property's table, or a column that is a property.

● Chain First Grondwaarheid string

With ChainSecond, the property chain that concludes this property (OWL propertyChainAxiom): a ChainFirst link followed by a ChainSecond link.

● Chain Second Grondwaarheid string

The chain's second link. Set together with ChainFirst.

● Disjoint With Grondwaarheid string

Properties that never both hold between the same two things (OWL propertyDisjointWith). Several are separated by ', '.

📘 Talisman's South Park ontology explainer: the concept form Documentação

This ontology in the concept form: a table of individuals, a table per class, a table or a column per property, and ERBTables and ERBFields for what the structure cannot say. orchestration/ontology_form.py wrote it; injecting it over the ontology brings the ontology's things, properties, axioms and facts in line with these tables.

Regras de negócio declarativas geradas a partir do livro de regras — a única fonte da verdade. Cada enunciado é a leitura em linguagem clara de uma fórmula; nada aqui é prosa manual.

Use as no canto superior direito para ligar ou desligar cada parte da documentação — Documentação, a leitura clara, a fórmula bruta, a descrição do autor e os links para entradas e consumidores de uma regra. A sua escolha fica memorizada.

📘 Talisman's South Park ontology explainer: the concept form Документация

This ontology in the concept form: a table of individuals, a table per class, a table or a column per property, and ERBTables and ERBFields for what the structure cannot say. orchestration/ontology_form.py wrote it; injecting it over the ontology brings the ontology's things, properties, axioms and facts in line with these tables.

Декларативные бизнес-правила, построенные из книги правил — единственного источника истины. Каждое утверждение — прочтение формулы на простом языке; ручной прозы здесь нет.

Используйте в правом верхнем углу, чтобы включать и выключать части документации — Документация, простое прочтение, сырую формулу, описание автора и ссылки на входы и потребителей правила. Выбор запоминается.

Сущности

  • Thing 0 правил · 1 связей
  • Person 0 правил · 1 связей
  • School 0 правил · 1 связей
  • is Parent of 0 правил · 2 связей
  • is Child of 0 правил · 2 связей
  • is Spouse of 0 правил · 2 связей
  • is Friend of 0 правил · 2 связей
  • attend 0 правил · 2 связей
  • has Age 0 правил · 1 связей
  • is Grandparent of 0 правил · 2 связей
  • Portrait 1 правил · 0 связей
  • ERB Table 0 правил · 2 связей
  • ERB Field 0 правил · 1 связей

Thing

Every individual of the ontology (owl:Thing). A class's table lists the individuals that belong to it.

● Label Первичная истина string

The name the page shows.

● Sort Order Первичная истина integer

Position in the cast.

⇢ Portrait Отношение string

The portrait drawn for this thing; set when its name matches a portrait alias.

Указатель на Portrait. Он ни из чего не выводится — это связь, на которой держится остальной DAG.

Randy 2

Person

The class Person: one row per individual that belongs to it. Its label and place are its ERBTables row.

⇢ Thing Отношение string

The individual's row in Things.

Указатель на Thing. Он ни из чего не выводится — это связь, на которой держится остальной DAG.

● Is Asserted Первичная истина boolean

True when a fact states it is a Person. False when only a property's domain or range implies it: such a row follows from the facts and is not added by hand.

● has Grade Level Первичная истина integer

has grade level: the one current value. A property of the ontology; its other attributes are its ERBFields row.

● has Role Первичная истина string

has role: the one current value. A property of the ontology; its other attributes are its ERBFields row.

ERB Table

One row per table of this rulebook (the platform's Schema module), and on it what the table's structure does not say. A class: its label and its place in the cast. A property that is a table: its label, its wording on the page, whether it is symmetric, and its inverse, chain and disjoint axioms. What a table IS is read from its fields: Thing and IsAsserted make a class; Subject with Object or Value make a property, whose domain and range are the tables they link to.

● Table Name Первичная истина string

The table's name again, as a plain column.

● Description Первичная истина string

What the table holds. Follows the table.

● Is Meta Table Первичная истина boolean

True for a table that serves the rulebook itself (ERBTables, ERBFields) and not the ontology.

● Is Tenant Scoped Первичная истина boolean

The Schema module's: rows belong to one tenant. Not used by the ontology.

⇢ Tenant Parent Table Отношение string

The Schema module's: the table tenancy is reached through. Not used by the ontology.

Указатель на ERB Table. Он ни из чего не выводится — это связь, на которой держится остальной DAG.

● Tenant Parent Field Первичная истина string

The Schema module's: the field that points at TenantParentTable. Not used by the ontology.

● Sort Order Первичная истина integer

Display order. For a class: Position in the cast. For a property: Position in the Add fact form's property list.

● Label Первичная истина string

For a class: The name the page shows. For a property: The property's wording on the page.

⇢ Portrait Отношение string

For a class: The portrait drawn for this thing; set when its name matches a portrait alias.

Указатель на Portrait. Он ни из чего не выводится — это связь, на которой держится остальной DAG.

● Is User Addable Первичная истина boolean

For a property: Offered in the page's Add fact form.

● Is Symmetric Первичная истина boolean

For a property: The symmetric rule makes this link true in both directions.

● Value Node Label Первичная истина string

For a property: The small label under a value node for this property: 'role value' or 'number value'.

● Current Value Wording Первичная истина string

For a property: How the Add fact form names a replaced value, as in 'Stan now has grade level 5'.

● Input Name Первичная истина string

For a property: How the integer check names this property's value, as in 'for grade level'.

● Record Kind Первичная истина string

For a property: The word the current-record summary uses for this property's values: role, grade or school.

● Record Order Первичная истина integer

For a property: Position of this property in the current-record summary.

● Inverse of Первичная истина string

The property that reads this one backwards (OWL inverseOf): when A has this link to B, the inverse rule concludes that B has that one to A. Names a property: a property's table, or a column that is a property.

● Chain First Первичная истина string

With ChainSecond, the property chain that concludes this property (OWL propertyChainAxiom): a ChainFirst link followed by a ChainSecond link.

● Chain Second Первичная истина string

The chain's second link. Set together with ChainFirst.

● Disjoint With Первичная истина string

Properties that never both hold between the same two things (OWL propertyDisjointWith). Several are separated by ', '.

ERB Field

One row per field of every table (the platform's Schema module), and on it the same attributes for a property that is a column: a property with one current value, on its domain's class table (on Things when it has no domain class).

⇢ ERB Table Отношение string

The table the field is on.

Указатель на ERB Table. Он ни из чего не выводится — это связь, на которой держится остальной DAG.

● Field Name Первичная истина string

The field's name. For a column that is a property: the property's id.

● Field Type Первичная истина string

raw or relationship. Follows the field.

● Datatype Первичная истина string

The rulebook datatype. Follows the field.

● Is Primary Key Первичная истина boolean

True for the field that identifies a row of its table.

● Description Первичная истина string

What the field means. Follows the field.

● Label Первичная истина string

For a property: The property's wording on the page.

For a property: Offered in the page's Add fact form.

For a property: The symmetric rule makes this link true in both directions.

● Sort Order Первичная истина integer

For a property: Position in the Add fact form's property list.

● Record Order Первичная истина integer

● Inverse of Первичная истина string

The property that reads this one backwards (OWL inverseOf): when A has this link to B, the inverse rule concludes that B has that one to A. Names a property: a property's table, or a column that is a property.

● Chain First Первичная истина string

With ChainSecond, the property chain that concludes this property (OWL propertyChainAxiom): a ChainFirst link followed by a ChainSecond link.

● Chain Second Первичная истина string

The chain's second link. Set together with ChainFirst.

This ontology in the concept form: a table of individuals, a table per class, a table or a column per property, and ERBTables and ERBFields for what the structure cannot say. orchestration/ontology_form.py wrote it; injecting it over the ontology brings the ontology's things, properties, axioms and facts in line with these tables.

ERB Table

One row per table of this rulebook (the platform's Schema module), and on it what the table's structure does not say. A class: its label and its place in the cast. A property that is a table: its label, its wording on the page, whether it is symmetric, and its inverse, chain and disjoint axioms. What a table IS is read from its fields: Thing and IsAsserted make a class; Subject with Object or Value make a property, whose domain and range are the tables they link to.

● Table Name Temel veri string

The table's name again, as a plain column.

● Description Temel veri string

What the table holds. Follows the table.

● Is Meta Table Temel veri boolean

True for a table that serves the rulebook itself (ERBTables, ERBFields) and not the ontology.

● Is Tenant Scoped Temel veri boolean

The Schema module's: rows belong to one tenant. Not used by the ontology.

⇢ Tenant Parent Table İlişki string

The Schema module's: the table tenancy is reached through. Not used by the ontology.

● Tenant Parent Field Temel veri string

The Schema module's: the field that points at TenantParentTable. Not used by the ontology.

● Sort Order Temel veri integer

Display order. For a class: Position in the cast. For a property: Position in the Add fact form's property list.

● Label Temel veri string

For a class: The name the page shows. For a property: The property's wording on the page.

⇢ Portrait İlişki string

For a class: The portrait drawn for this thing; set when its name matches a portrait alias.

Bir referans (hedef: Portrait). Başka hiçbir şeyden türetilmez — DAG yapısının geri kalanının bağlandığı bağlantıdır.

For a property: Offered in the page's Add fact form.

For a property: The symmetric rule makes this link true in both directions.

For a property: The small label under a value node for this property: 'role value' or 'number value'.

● Current Value Wording Temel veri string

For a property: How the Add fact form names a replaced value, as in 'Stan now has grade level 5'.

● Input Name Temel veri string

For a property: How the integer check names this property's value, as in 'for grade level'.

● Record Kind Temel veri string

For a property: The word the current-record summary uses for this property's values: role, grade or school.

● Record Order Temel veri integer

For a property: Position of this property in the current-record summary.

● Inverse of Temel veri string

The property that reads this one backwards (OWL inverseOf): when A has this link to B, the inverse rule concludes that B has that one to A. Names a property: a property's table, or a column that is a property.

● Chain First Temel veri string

With ChainSecond, the property chain that concludes this property (OWL propertyChainAxiom): a ChainFirst link followed by a ChainSecond link.

● Chain Second Temel veri string

The chain's second link. Set together with ChainFirst.

● Disjoint With Temel veri string

Properties that never both hold between the same two things (OWL propertyDisjointWith). Several are separated by ', '.

📘 Talisman's South Park ontology explainer: the concept form Tài liệu
›

Hiển thị trong tài liệu này

📘 Talisman's South Park ontology explainer: the concept form Tài liệu

This ontology in the concept form: a table of individuals, a table per class, a table or a column per property, and ERBTables and ERBFields for what the structure cannot say. orchestration/ontology_form.py wrote it; injecting it over the ontology brings the ontology's things, properties, axioms and facts in line with these tables.

Các quy tắc nghiệp vụ dạng khai báo, được sinh ra từ bộ quy tắc — nguồn sự thật duy nhất. Mỗi phát biểu dưới đây là cách đọc một công thức bằng lời thông thường; không có nội dung nào ở đây được viết tay.

Dùng ở góc trên bên phải để bật hoặc tắt từng phần của tài liệu — Tài liệu, cách đọc thông thường, công thức gốc, mô tả của tác giả, cùng các liên kết tới đầu vào và nơi sử dụng của mỗi quy tắc. Lựa chọn của bạn sẽ được ghi nhớ.

Thực thể

  • Thing 0 quy tắc · 1 liên kết
  • Person 0 quy tắc · 1 liên kết
  • School 0 quy tắc · 1 liên kết
  • is Parent of 0 quy tắc · 2 liên kết
  • is Child of 0 quy tắc · 2 liên kết
  • is Spouse of 0 quy tắc · 2 liên kết
  • is Friend of 0 quy tắc · 2 liên kết
  • attend 0 quy tắc · 2 liên kết
  • has Age 0 quy tắc · 1 liên kết
  • is Grandparent of 0 quy tắc · 2 liên kết
  • Portrait 1 quy tắc · 0 liên kết
  • ERB Table 0 quy tắc · 2 liên kết
  • ERB Field 0 quy tắc · 1 liên kết

raw or relationship. Follows the field.

● Datatype Dữ liệu gốc string

The rulebook datatype. Follows the field.

What the field means. Follows the field.

For a property: The property's wording on the page.

For a property: Offered in the page's Add fact form.

For a property: The symmetric rule makes this link true in both directions.

● Sort Order Dữ liệu gốc integer

For a property: Position in the Add fact form's property list.

For a property: The small label under a value node for this property: 'role value' or 'number value'.

For a property: How the Add fact form names a replaced value, as in 'Stan now has grade level 5'.

● Input Name Dữ liệu gốc string

For a property: How the integer check names this property's value, as in 'for grade level'.

● Record Kind Dữ liệu gốc string

For a property: The word the current-record summary uses for this property's values: role, grade or school.

For a property: Position of this property in the current-record summary.

The property that reads this one backwards (OWL inverseOf): when A has this link to B, the inverse rule concludes that B has that one to A. Names a property: a property's table, or a column that is a property.

● Chain Second Dữ liệu gốc string

The chain's second link. Set together with ChainFirst.

📘 Talisman's South Park ontology explainer: the concept form 文档

This ontology in the concept form: a table of individuals, a table per class, a table or a column per property, and ERBTables and ERBFields for what the structure cannot say. orchestration/ontology_form.py wrote it; injecting it over the ontology brings the ontology's things, properties, axioms and facts in line with these tables.

由规则手册——唯一的真实来源——生成的声明式业务规则。以下每个语句都是某条公式的通俗读法;这里没有任何手写文字。

使用右上角的 打开或关闭文档的各个部分——文档、通俗读法、原始公式、作者说明,以及规则的输入与使用方链接。您的选择会被记住。

ERB Table

One row per table of this rulebook (the platform's Schema module), and on it what the table's structure does not say. A class: its label and its place in the cast. A property that is a table: its label, its wording on the page, whether it is symmetric, and its inverse, chain and disjoint axioms. What a table IS is read from its fields: Thing and IsAsserted make a class; Subject with Object or Value make a property, whose domain and range are the tables they link to.

● Table Name 基础事实 string

The table's name again, as a plain column.

● Description 基础事实 string

What the table holds. Follows the table.

● Is Meta Table 基础事实 boolean

True for a table that serves the rulebook itself (ERBTables, ERBFields) and not the ontology.

● Is Tenant Scoped 基础事实 boolean

The Schema module's: rows belong to one tenant. Not used by the ontology.

⇢ Tenant Parent Table 关系 string

The Schema module's: the table tenancy is reached through. Not used by the ontology.

一个指针(指向 ERB Table)。它不由任何东西推导——它是整个 DAG 悬挂其上的关联。

● Tenant Parent Field 基础事实 string

The Schema module's: the field that points at TenantParentTable. Not used by the ontology.

● Sort Order 基础事实 integer

Display order. For a class: Position in the cast. For a property: Position in the Add fact form's property list.

● Label 基础事实 string

For a class: The name the page shows. For a property: The property's wording on the page.

⇢ Portrait 关系 string

For a class: The portrait drawn for this thing; set when its name matches a portrait alias.

一个指针(指向 Portrait)。它不由任何东西推导——它是整个 DAG 悬挂其上的关联。

● Is User Addable 基础事实 boolean

For a property: Offered in the page's Add fact form.

For a property: The symmetric rule makes this link true in both directions.

● Current Value Wording 基础事实 string

For a property: How the Add fact form names a replaced value, as in 'Stan now has grade level 5'.

● Input Name 基础事实 string

For a property: How the integer check names this property's value, as in 'for grade level'.

● Record Kind 基础事实 string

For a property: The word the current-record summary uses for this property's values: role, grade or school.

● Record Order 基础事实 integer

For a property: Position of this property in the current-record summary.

The property that reads this one backwards (OWL inverseOf): when A has this link to B, the inverse rule concludes that B has that one to A. Names a property: a property's table, or a column that is a property.
